draft.title: Classifying movement skills
card: Fundamental and sport-specific
Fundamental skills are basic movements such as running, jumping and catching. Sport-specific skills are built from them for one sport, such as a netball shoulder pass.
Gross and fine
Gross skills use large muscle groups, such as a long jump. Fine skills use small muscles for precise control, such as a dart throw.
Open and closed
Open skills are done in a changing environment, so the performer must react, such as a tackle. Closed skills are done in a stable, predictable setting, such as a free throw.
Discrete, serial and continuous

A discrete skill has a clear start and end, such as a golf putt. A serial skill links several discrete skills in order, such as a gymnastics routine. A continuous skill repeats with no clear start or end, such as swimming laps.
draft.remember: Each skill can be described in several ways: by its basis, muscle size, environment and timing.

a.q: A tennis player returns a serve that bounces differently each time, so she must adjust her swing. Which type of skill is this?
a.why: The environment changes with each serve, so the player must react. That makes the skill open. Closed skills happen in a stable, predictable setting, which is not the case here.
a.clue: Think about whether the setting stays the same each time.

b.q: Ravi performs a triple jump: a hop, a step and then a jump, done one straight after another. How is this skill best classed by its timing?
b.why: The triple jump links three separate movements in a set order, so it is serial. It is not discrete, because it is not a single movement. It is not continuous, because it has a clear start and end and does not repeat.
b.clue: Count the separate movements and check whether they repeat.

a.q: A tennis player returns a serve that bounces differently each time, so she must adjust her swing. How is this skill classed by its environment, and why?
opts: Open, because the setting keeps changing
Closed, because every serve follows set rules

Closed, because it has a clear start and end
